description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's React Native SDK (works in Expo too), pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Install through npm aliases so every import stays unchanged: "react-native-purchases": "npm:@revenuedot/react-native-purchases@<version>" and the same for react-native-purchases-ui.
Keep `import Purchases from "react-native-purchases"`. Then run `npx pod-install` (bare React Native) or `npx expo prebuild` (Expo).
RevenueDot Cloud (https://api.revenuedot.app) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, call `await Purchases.setProxyURL("https://revenuedot.example.com")` before `Purchases.configure`.
Pass each app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard to `Purchases.configure`: appl_ for iOS and goog_ for Android.
